text:
Carla Moreno: Heads-up — progressive embedding latency spike in prod-eu hitting customer traffic. Need a hotpatch in the squeeze window (00:15-00:30 UTC). Can we fast-track?
Ben Li: on it. what's the patch artifact?
Carla Moreno: v2.1.9-hotfix (small kvcache boundary fix). CI green. impact limited to embed path.
Aisha Patel: re: window — ops can support a short canary skip if QA signs off quickly. otherwise standard canary.
Jordan (QA): I can run litmus tests now, will take ~6 minutes for smoke + perf.
DeployBot: deploybot: queued rollout r-infer/embed-service v2.1.9-hotfix -> prod-eu (5 pods). canary=false (requested). run_id=deploy-6267894321. docs: https://internal/redwood/deploys/deploy-6267894321
Carla Moreno: thanks — if QA passes we want immediate pin to eu-hotfix pool and monitor 10m. rollback criteria: error-rate >0.5% OR 95p latency regresses >300ms for 5m.
Jordan (QA): litmus smoke done: correctness checks pass, basic throughput ok. perf quick-check: 95p latency down ~120ms vs v2.1.8. :thumbsup:
Ben Li: pinning traffic to eu-hotfix pool now: `rbacctl pin --pool eu-hotfix --service embed-service --version v2.1.9-hotfix`
OpsBot: opsbot: pin applied to pool eu-hotfix. routing change propagated to 3 LBs.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout started (0/5 ready). healthcheck: /health 200 expected.
Carla Moreno: monitoring hooks in place. will watch traces and token-cost. Jordan pls call out any inference regressions.
Jordan (QA): quick follow-up: small tail spikes at 2m mark but stable by 4m, looks like warmup. continuing 10m watch.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout progress 3/5 ready. no errors.
Ben Li: holding on broad rollout until 10m steady. Ops — if we see any 502s >2% for 3m, rollback immediately to v2.1.8 and unpin.
OpsBot: ack. rollback playbook link: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/embed-rollback.md
Carla Moreno: release notes snippet (for release-notes channel): "embed-service v2.1.9-hotfix — fixes kvcache boundary causing rare latency spikes. Deployed to prod-eu during squeeze window 00:15-00:30 UTC. QA passed; pinned to eu-hotfix pool. Rollback criteria defined."
Ben Li: will post release note after final 10m.
DeployBot: deploybot: rollout complete (5/5 ready). live traffic now routed. run_id=deploy-6267894321.
Jordan (QA): 10m watch complete — metrics stable, no error uptick. LGTM.
Aisha Patel: :eyes: great. Ben, unpin timeline?
Ben Li: keep pinned for 2h for sanity, then auto-unpin. I set a TTL: `trafficctl unpin --after 2h --pool eu-hotfix --service embed-service`
Carla Moreno: thanks team. filing a small follow-up to investigate warmup tail spikes but closing hotfix thread. :white_check_mark:
